bullets.content: [general] Use the whole budget, one factor per solve or check, stated in advance: base (a new variant, never a stored recipe), one-factor changes, one structurally different recipe, refine at hotspots. Budgets differ by task (here 12 linear solves, 6 nonlinear_checks). Free mesh() scan first.

[general] Use all 6 nonlinear_checks with a written plan: at most 2 on the known family, at least 3 on new structural targets, 1 spare. g7: a3 used 2, a2 3, a1 4, and three runs ended on noise ties. With no new idea, run the tool-0016 diagnostic (h 0.006 control).

[general] Keep promises: promised view(kind=error) after the first solve was skipped again by all four agents. Call solve() + view(error) on the control first, compare each hotspot's local h with box size, list carrier hotspots with h >0.0045, then plan checks.

[general] Once a family plateaus inside noise (±0.1-0.15 pt), stop one-factor size or h scans. a1 spent 6 checks on h and a0 3 on arm size, all noise. Use at most 2 checks on the known family and at least 3 on new targets or node cuts, each against a same-h control.

[general] Before each check write break-even e < best product/nodes; a result within 0.1 pt is a tie, so move to a new structural target. Scan candidates with free mesh() first (node counts are branchy, non-monotone) and check only the cheapest variant of each target.

[general] Keep your own gates (e.g. nodes <=6300, q>=0.2). a2 checked an 8525-node mesh (break-even 1.65%, got 2.22%). If a mesh breaks the gate, run it as a linear-reaction experiment instead of a nonlinear check.
[general] Never resubmit a previous recipe unchanged: a3 g4 control fell 0.916->0.816; a2 resubmitted g6 mesh and got 0.846, no bonus. Submit a checked variant differing in targets or h.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: never re-solve a known recipe, never compare(n,n), never solve a mesh whose free mesh() changed nodes <1%. Identical meshes tie, no bonus: a0 and a2 both submitted the same 5686-node mesh. Compare targets with peers' before submitting; change one target structurally.

[general] After every linear solve call view(kind=error) and compare each hotspot's local h with the requested size. If it is >1.3x, extend or shrink the box over the hotspot. Write the plan first and keep its promises.

[general] mesh() replaces the active mesh and solve() uses the LAST mesh call. Re-issue the intended mesh() right before solve() and confirm the node count matches (a0 solved an unintended h 0.008 mesh).
[general] To submit a checked mesh, re-issue the identical mesh(), confirm node count equals the checked one, linear-solve, then submit.
[general] Point refinements are silent no-ops (node count unchanged: 5711->5714, 5661 identical). After every mesh() check node count; use {box} volumes over the hotspot band (e.g. ~3x9x2.5 mm).

[general] Box refinement radius is inert: radius 0.003 vs 0.0015 gave identical meshes (6164 nodes). Don't spend solves on radii; box size and extent are the knobs. Check any new parameter with a free mesh() node count.

[general] Delivered size lags requested by ~1.25-1.4x in thin bands (0.0022->0.0028, 0.0018->0.0026, 0.0035->0.0045). Request ~0.7-0.8x wanted local h; confirm via 'element size near group' and hotspot h. If quality.min <0.105 shift h by 0.0005 or box by 0.0002.
[general] Edge refinement inside a box of similar size is a no-op (bc0: edge 22 at 0.003 in 0.0035 box changed energy 0.004%). Make local refinements >=1.4x finer than surrounding size, or omit.

[general] Thin walls (e.g. prong walls around nut pockets): read thickness from inspect_geometry. In high-stress bands keep local size <= thickness, with 3-4 quadratic elements across the wall. Coarse h gives under one element across and 20-30% local error.
[general] When two refinement boxes meet, overlap them ~3 mm (e.g. lower box to z 0.021, junction from 0.018); at coarse h a coarse seam forms (a4 read 9% low at z≈0.015).

[general] Branch scanning is free and decisive. Free-mesh 6-8 neighbours (size ±0.0003, box edges ±0.0002, h ±0.0005). Prefer q>=0.2 siblings (q 0.22+ gave 2.51-2.82%, q 0.11-0.145 gave 3.08-3.54%), but the rule is a guide: a3's q 0.108 gave 2.45%. Confirm q>=0.1 and node count before submit.

[general] Mirrored boxes over symmetric yield corners matched face groups (a3 2.45% vs 2.51%, +11 nodes) and count as different targets for diversity. Prefer a box spanning the corner ±3 mm through full thickness over many small face groups.

[general] Above the 2x target, score ∝ 1/(e x nodes). When e is stuck, cut nodes: trim boxes over low-PEEQ zones and delete boxes <1.5x finer than surroundings. Move one box edge per free mesh(); keep cuts >=2% with q>=0.1. a2 gained +0.03 from one edge move.

[general] Before trusting a 'symmetric' group list from a brief or playbook, use inspect_geometry to confirm the listed faces' centroids appear at both +x and -x. Here f38-f42 were all at x>0; the other prong had f36/f37/f55.

[general] Uniform refinement is break-even or worse (bc7 p≈0.44; here the 1.1% floor makes it lose outright). Gains come from moving DOFs into the error or plastic bands and coarsening elsewhere (bc7: h 0.0052 plus targeted edges beat uniform 0.0042).

[general] Bonuses decide rank. List peers' known targets, pick one nobody uses; keep base >=90% of best. On a plateau (2.21-2.30%, products 12.9-13.2k) trims and pocket/arm/h tweaks are noise (±0.1 pt): spend >=3 of 6 checks on the large-response lever (carrier size).

[general] On field-scored tasks the reference-free estimate understates true error (x1.22 bc7, ~1.5x bc0), and compare diffs below 5% are noise. On test-scored tasks the estimate only places elements; judge by nonlinear_check e.
[general] A compare() diff with >90% share in one low-stress spot is a remesh artifact (a7 bc0: 0.611, energies agreed 2e-5). Check view(kind=error) and judge by hotspots and energy.

[general] A high linear stress hotspot is not automatically a lever (f5, f6 here). Rank regions by where cells are coarse AND the nonlinear PEEQ or error view is non-zero outside every box. Read hotspots' local h vs box sizes in view(kind=error).
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Below e 3.92%, score ~ 11510/(e% x nodes): minimise e x nodes. Best now 13.9k (a1); break-even e < 13900/nodes. Differences <=0.1 pt are noise.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Above e 3.92%, score = (3.92/e%)^2 x 2937/nodes, a quadratic penalty. Automesher: 2937 nodes, 7.8% = 0.25; swarm bc0 mesh: 6430 nodes, 4.6% = 0.34. Get e under ~3% first, then cut nodes. Break-even below 3.92%: +x% nodes must cut e by x/(1+x) (+20% nodes needs -17% e).

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Peak PEEQ at singular hex corners tracks local element size/form (groups 0.414 vs boxes 0.31-0.35, same curve). Never choose a mesh by peak PEEQ or stress; judge by nonlinear_check e and e x nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] The 1.0 mm point (+5.7-5.9% on ~35 checks) is excess elastic stiffness; converged uniform meshes reach ~1.1%. Proxy: linear total platen reaction f17+f34. Compare control, h 0.006, carrier 0.0032, base-top box; check only where reaction drops most per node.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Setup is not scored; all g8 runs used the statement's setup verbatim (f17/f34 u_y -0.0024, E 1.88e9, nu 0.35, base_bottom fixed). Differences are mesh only.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Coarse-h diversity is dead: h 0.009-0.0125 gives 6989-9902 nodes. Diversify inside the load path instead (split carrier, finer lower band).

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier top 0.035->0.032 cut 188 nodes, doubled q at equal e (prong tops y>29 mm low plastic). Use 0.032 default; 0.030/0.031 jump to ~6800 nodes, 0.033 gives 5623 (q 0.136). Don't scan further; try other low-PEEQ edges, e.g. pocket-box y-max 0.0285, one free mesh each.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Neck boxes [0.024,-0.025,-0.0082,0.031,-0.016,0.0082] plus mirror gave 2.42% vs 2.55% for +58 nodes at h 0.0082 (a3), but in g7 neck boxes reaching |x|>0.024 went to 6691-6980 nodes. Free-mesh; reject above 5900.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Arm boxes 0.0034 in a 0.004 carrier are droppable: a no-arm mesh with centre slab 0.006 [-0.019,-0.03,..,0.019,-0.017] gave 5686 nodes, q 0.273, 2.30% (a0,a2, identical, tied). Nested boxes <1.5x finer are inert; delete them.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Spend one nonlinear_check as diagnostic: control with h 0.006 (refines all outside carrier). If the 1.0 mm point drops >1 pt, stiffness error lies outside the carrier; then free-mesh a box at 0.005 over y -0.03..-0.02 full x and check that.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Do not refine bore flank f5 (|x| 13-15, y -13..-15, s1 45-48 MPa): a0 f5 boxes 0.0028 gave 2.39% at 6255 nodes (14.95k). Settled, no checks: pocket 0.0025-0.0028, carrier 0.004, bottom y -0.02, h 0.0077-0.0083 (map: 0.0077-0.008 safe; 0.0074-0.00775 hits 7176-7240 branch; noise ±0.12 pt).

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Plateau: carrier 0.004 + pocket 0.0025-0.003 (box or groups), h 0.0077-0.0084 gave 2.40-2.68% at 5592-6030 nodes over ~18 checks, best product 13.9k (a1: 5737 nodes, 2.42%). No more checks on pocket size, edge twins, carrier size or small h shifts.

[abc_00000065_compression] [general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier size is the dominant lever: 0.0048 gave 3.37% vs 2.30% at 0.004 (-82 nodes, 1.0 mm point 5.7->6.6%). Never coarsen. First check: carrier 0.0036-0.0039 at h 0.0078-0.0082, q>=0.15, <=6300 nodes; break-even e<12910/nodes. Node counts non-monotone (0.0045->6278, 0.005->5402).
